This includes optimizing heavy Anthology legacy processes, consolidating scattered automations, improving Inbound Interest Forms through HTML rendering, introducing intuitive workload dashboards, and expanding AI-enabled tools like Cresta and Apten to reduce busy work and improve the user and student experience. Optimizing high-volume legacy workflows will not only improve the Admissions user experience, but also strengthen overall system health, performance, and long-term scalability.
